newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-MEDIENOS RESULTS NOT SEEN HITTING SHARE PRICE.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-MEDIENOS RESULTS NOT SEEN HITTING SHARE PRICE.

text.p: Medienos Plaushas' 1.8 million litas six-month profits will do little to affect the price of its shares on the Vilnius bourse, brokers and analysts said on Thursday.
The six-month profit was up from the 1.3 million litas for the same period last year but lower than the company's projection earlier this month of two million litas.
The company says it is still on track for four million litas profits for the year.
"I think the profits the company announced were more or less what the market expected," said Leonas Lingis, an analyst with Vilfima.
"I don't think this information will be reflected in its share price," Lingis said.
Medienos shares started at 12 litas on Monday before jumping to 12.75 litas on Tuesday and easing to 12.50 litas on Wednesday.
Brokers said the 200,000 litas difference in the projected and actual profit is insignificant and the increase from last year was more important.
"With blue-chip companies, the profit is always growing," said Tomas Andrejauskas, a broker with Suprema, adding that the 1.8 million litas was in line with expectations.
Medienos Plaushas is one of three corporates on the five-company official list of Lithuania's stock exchange.
The company, which manufactures cardboard, said the two million litas mark was missed because of maintenance work in its fibre board production area.
"It's a little bit lower, but it doesn't mean that something special will happen (with the share price)," Andrejauskas said.
"This is a stable company with stable financial results," said Saulius Racevichius, director of the financial brokerage department at Vilniaus Bank.
